metadata.title: HKUST Clear Water Bay OpenStreetMap geometry
notes: All footprint and road coordinates are OSM source data, not survey measurements.
No building heights are guessed in this asset. Null heightMeters means unavailable. Levels can be used to estimate height, but that estimate must be labelled.
inCampus uses feature mean-coordinate inclusion in OSM campus boundary. Roads may cross the boundary.
Rendering x,z coordinate pairs are available as points; y is vertical height.
Polygon rings remain closed. Building outlines are intact; roads, coastline and large landcovers are clipped to bbox.
